title: Osero pairs capital allocation into Sky's collateral portfolio with running a lending platform for stablecoin distribution hubs
content:
A.6.1.1.7.1 introduces Osero as "an Agent focused on building credit infrastructure for onchain and traditional finance, with a focus on USD₮ liquidity." Two distinct functions are then named in the same sentence-pair, and the pairing is what makes the mandate unusual.

The first is the familiar Agent function: "allocating capital to scale Sky's collateral portfolio." The second is a platform function — Osero "serves as a platform enabling stablecoin distribution hubs—including exchanges, wallets, and neobanks—to access institutional grade lending infrastructure underpinning USDS through a suite of products."

Those are different businesses with different counterparties. Capital allocation makes Osero a balance-sheet actor whose performance shows up in Sky's collateral quality. The platform role makes Osero an intermediary selling access to third parties who themselves distribute stablecoins.

The strategic bet is that the two reinforce each other: distribution hubs that borrow through Osero become demand for USDS, while the collateral Osero originates for them is the same collateral Sky underwrites. The risk is the mirror image — Osero's platform customers and Sky's collateral exposure are the same book, so a failure in the distribution channel is not diversified away from the collateral portfolio.

The explicit USD₮ (Tether) focus is also notable for an Agent whose output backs a competing stablecoin: Osero's role is to route non-Sky dollar liquidity into structures that support USDS.
description: Two roles in one Agent: deploy capital to scale Sky collateral, and let exchanges, wallets and neobanks reach the institutional-grade credit infrastructure underpinning USDS.
